files.about: The workbook's design: sheets, tables, pivots, charts.
The Python automation that builds the workbook.

words.title: Accounting workbook
words.for_whom: For accountants who hand over the same Excel workbook every month or quarter.
words.explain: Design the workbook once: sheets of tables, pivots and charts from your data. A Python automation builds it again whenever the data changes. You get data.ipynb, workbook.design.json and workbook.py.
words.example: Example: the quarterly cession statements for each reinsurer, built in one click.
